text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day.
A gust of wind blew some important documents
straight up into a tree……!
choice_data_list: Ugh, it's just barely out of reach……!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ――Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I will take it.
, please step back.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it.
Turning a blind eye to someone in need
—would only dull my blade.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Ha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She leaped high into the air……!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Take this! Augenblickââ
SLASH!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a sharp thrust of the broom into the tree branch,
she forcefully knocked the paperwork right out……!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ――Phew, here you go.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: No, I merely did what anyone would do—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Whoa... Durandal-san looks so gallant again today!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: She calls herself a knight, but she really does feel like a true knight~!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...My heart remains ever steadfast in that regard.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, that is all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As Durandal walked away with gallant dignity, I couldn't help but call out to her back—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...Anyone aspiring to the path of chivalry would naturally have done the exact same thing.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
So, no thanks are necessary.
Instead, I only ask that you remember my name.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
When you require my presence and call my name
—I shall bear the holy blade and lend you my strength.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...Augenblick Slash.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes, its power was impeccable.
And it sounds totally cool too.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Looking it up in the name dictionary
was totally worth it...!
I'm definitely making this one of my signature moves...!
